notes.title: Border Bots VR is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Border Bots VR is Out Now on SteamVR![/h2]
Light-hearted VR puzzle job-sim game, Border Bots VR has just launched for SteamVR! Immerse yourself in a futuristic megacity, operate a border checkpoint and meet a variety of quirky robots.

[previewyoutube=Nfb4op8R2y0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]⛽ ENTER A ROBOT FUELLED FUTURE[/h3]
Border Bots VR tasks players with managing the flow of robots into the city after an incident sees them mysteriously malfunctioning... Get to the bottom of it, Number One!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/45f7d015832391969c8e83c2f0e6aeef7f49dcab.gif[/img]
[h3]✅ OPERATE THE BORDERS[/h3]
Check documents for discrepancies and robots for unauthorised modifications while confiscating forbidden items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/9d4a6e46e5b3996ad99ecddbb98c628fd7b75a05.gif[/img]
[h3]🖨️ UTILISE QUIRKY GADGETS[/h3]
Ensure a hard day’s work with an array of handy gadgets such as a 3D Printer, Barcode Scanner, and Contraband Detector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/c46a8e1d74b214f53fd9ed74b4a7308d26fe7541.gif[/img]
[h3]🤖 MEET MECHANICAL FRIENDS[/h3]
Interact with a host of friendly assistant AI and mechanical denizens, ensuring they have the necessary clearance to enter the city, and aren’t concealing any unauthorised items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/0a51c704111114907f58343f8e5027be9478405e.gif[/img]
[h3]🪜 RISE UP THE LADDER[/h3]
Rise up the corporate ladder by purchasing upgrades, gadgets, and booth enhancements, and keep an eye on the competition with performance review leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/3f8a5a65731ff9308b0dfbb597e5e20fb732efcf.gif[/img]
[h2]Happy Launch Day! 🥳[/h2]
We are so excited to see you play Border Bots VR, interacting with our quirky robots and can't wait to read your thoughts about our VR game!

If you enjoy Border Bots VR, consider [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/874440/reviews/]leaving a Steam review here.[/url]
[h2]Support[/h2]
If you do run into any bugs in Border Bots VR, please get in contact with our [url=https://www.team17.com/support/]Support Team here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/970690ccd79350668e68a7ecf9413389c8560d96.gif[/img]

That's all for today folks! 👋

notes.title: Dev Diary I Border Bots VR releases in less than a week! 👀
notes.content:
[h2]Discover Vtime Games' Dev Diary for Border Bots VR[/h2]
Hey all! Today we have a Dev Diary to showcase to the community from the developers of Border Bots VR- Vtime Games. This Dev Diary explores Border Bots VR's creation, inspirations, characters, comedic gameplay and more.

[previewyoutube=cVY_g_hRa5w;full][/previewyoutube][h3]Border Bots VR releases on 8th February for SteamVR! [/h3]
Ready to transport yourself into a robot-led future? Border Bots VR tasks players with managing the flow of robots into the city after an incident sees them mysteriously malfunctioning, placing them into the boots of a human border agent stationed within a futuristic megacity. Players will need to examine documents and employ the use of a variety of quirky gadgets, including a 3D printer, barcode scanner, and contraband detector, to interact with a host of friendly assistant AI and mechanical denizens, ensuring they have the necessary clearance to enter the city, and aren’t concealing any unauthorised items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/eaf6fca22fb5842e09a0add0d2d2ddaebeb3feab.jpg[/img]
[h3]Border Bots Key Features [/h3]
[b]Analyse:[/b] Check documents for discrepancies and robots for unauthorised modifications while confiscating forbidden items 

[b]Utilise:[/b] Ensure a hard day’s work with an array of handy gadgets such as a 3D Printer, Barcode Scanner, and Contraband Detector 

[b]Corporatise:[/b] Rise up the corporate ladder by purchasing upgrades, gadgets, and booth enhancements, and keep an eye on the competition with performance review leaderboards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/4cdfbf6ec876c1ac69f6758741e4fc90667c3a2a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Meet Burnie! 👋 I Border Bots VR
notes.content:
Hey all! Today we have our very first robot highlight for Border Bots VR:
[h3]Meet Burnie! 👋[/h3]
Burnie is a robot who's here for all your toasting needs. You meet Burnie in your apartment in the early days of Border Bots VR. Make sure you interact daily with this iconic robot! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/49a863d7f753300144208f80a34070617ae66858.gif[/img]
[h3]Questioning purpose[/h3]
Burnie asks the real questions and not just about bread! When interacting with this robot around your apartment in Border Bots VR, you'll find out he's questioning his purpose if he's not toasting things. So give Burnie a helping hand by finding items to toast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/847c8d3041361e0d8f97c1bd4b3e76d25a1a36d0.gif[/img]
[h3]Practise Toasting[/h3]
This robot needs to practise their talents and you are the key to this! If Burnie isn't toasting, how will he get his 10,000 hours in? Without this, there's no chance they can become an expert in their field. Don't leave him alone, that'd be crummy of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/4cdfbf6ec876c1ac69f6758741e4fc90667c3a2a.gif[/img]
[h3]Not just bread![/h3]
There are many ways to interact with this engaging robot in your apartment. Burnie's toasting needs don't stop at bread... but we will let you all explore this for yourselves in February! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/0c3371a1394bb4d25d2d805a8829278cafc8cccc.gif[/img]
[h2]In Case You Missed it[/h2]
Border Bots VR is a lighthearted single-player puzzle job-simulator set on a future earth where AI is in control. As a human border agent, you begin a new role as a booth operator at an AI travel border. Interact and check over a variety of robots as they try to get through security. Some of their credentials might not be up to scratch, it's up to you to make sure they get the stamp of approval.

Border Bots VR now releases on 8th February 2024 for SteamVR!

[h3]KEY FEATURES[/h3] 
ANALYSE
Check documents for discrepancies and robots for unauthorised modifications while confiscating forbidden items

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/eaf6fca22fb5842e09a0add0d2d2ddaebeb3feab.jpg[/img]
UTILISE
Ensure a hard day’s work with an array of handy gadgets such as a 3D Printer, Barcode Scanner, and Contraband Detector

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/0b8254539a66e2b767a95b28a4f2621c1ec8bbe2.jpg[/img]
CORPORATISE
Rise up the corporate ladder by purchasing upgrades, gadgets, and booth enhancements, and keep an eye on the competition with performance review leaderboards

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/c6c4147828aa0464ba71f0b048cc4f69ea2f1e23.jpg[/img]
That's all... for now! 👋
